breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification keeps W2=100 m/s and beta2=30 deg while asserting Va=106.1 m/s. Since W2*cos(beta2) = 100*cos(30°) ≈ 86.6 m/s ≠ 106.1 m/s, the inconsistency is not resolved. The ground truth fixes this by recalculating W2 = Va/cos(beta2) ≈ 122.5 m/s, but the generated text does not make this correction.
